name: 小草虫
evolution: 小草虫 → 草衣虫 Lv.20 → 花衣蝶 Lv.36
description: 果树分叉越多的地方，越容易找到它们，常常被误认为是未熟的青葡萄。肤表黏糊糊的，睡觉时缩成一团挂在树上。常观察到许多只挤在一起，目前推测是畏寒的原因。
descriptionEn: The more branching the fruit tree, the easier they are to find, often mistaken for unripe green grapes. Sticky on the surface, they curl up into a ball and hang on trees while sleeping. Many are often seen huddled together, currently speculated to be due to cold aversion.
